subject: Invitation to interview - Strategy & Advisory Intern
body:
Hi Jordan,

Great news: we would like to invite you to a final round interview for the Strategy & Advisory Intern role. The interview is on-site and runs about two hours with three partners.

Please let us know which of these times works for you: Nov 5 at 10 am, Nov 6 at 2 pm.

Halcyon Advisory Recruiting
